method: Independent numerical and analytic model checks, not renderer assertions.

checks.claim: All radius states preserve fixed-axis angular momentum.
The point-weight contribution quarters at half radius; nonzero platform inertia prevents a fourfold total speed increase.
Analytic angular phase agrees with independent numerical integration.
Final rotational kinetic energy increases when weights move inward.

limitations: No external torque or friction. Radial actuation supplies work. This is a constrained ideal platform with point weights, not a human skater or passive inward drift.
